# ibee_load_balancer_regions (Data Source)

Regions where load balancers can be created, as the API lists them, with what each supports.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ibee_load_balancer_regions" "available" {}

# Pass one of these IDs as ibee_load_balancer.region_id.
output "load_balancer_regions" {
  value = data.ibee_load_balancer_regions.available.ids
}

# Regions whose load balancers can send traffic to private VPC addresses; elsewhere,
# targets are VMs (or addresses the region reaches publicly).
output "private_target_regions" {
  value = [for r in data.ibee_load_balancer_regions.available.regions : r.id if r.capabilities.private_targets]
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | `list(string)` | Read-only | Region IDs, for region_id of ibee_load_balancer. |
| `regions` | `list(object)` | Read-only | Each region as the API lists it. |
| `regions.capabilities` | `single(object)` | Read-only | What load balancers in this region support. |
| `regions.capabilities.private_targets` | `bool` | Read-only | Targets can be private addresses in a VPC. When false, use VMs or addresses the region reaches publicly; a private target is refused with 422 target_not_usable. |
| `regions.capabilities.udp_firewall` | `bool` | Read-only | UDP listeners are protected by the region's network policy. |
| `regions.code` | `string` | Read-only | Region code, such as vga-dev. |
| `regions.id` | `string` | Read-only | Region ID, for region_id of ibee_load_balancer. |
| `regions.max_nodes` | `number` | Read-only | The most nodes one load balancer can have in this region. |
| `regions.name` | `string` | Read-only | Display name. |
| `regions.site_id` | `string` | Read-only | The site the region is in. |
